backup.production_rule: Back-end for the Manage hub. admin_save_transaction_v1 gains an optional, validated receipt_image_path (+ ocr_confidence, ocr_raw); four new functions (admin_review_queue_v1, admin_review_transaction_v1, expense_categories_v1, get_hospitality_series_v1); six slugs are added to expense_categories (internet, subscription, furnishing, cohost_fee, airbnb_adjustment, loan). No table, column or policy change and no transaction row is touched. Re-running is harmless (create or replace, insert where not exists). restore_point is a placeholder: the release block fills it (fill-restore-point.mjs). get_hospitality_series_v1 follows get_hospitality_metrics_v1 gate: effective roles owner, admin and finance (a cleaner is refused by the stays gate).
backup.notes: Deploy order: SQL first, then the ocr-receipt edge function (waves branch), then the Staff app. The migration refuses (55000) if admin_save_transaction_v1 is not the body with md5 147e217b6c7a14f264f7dfce43b8bb2f. No new secret.

forward_verification.name: save_body_accepts_a_receipt
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%receipt_image_path%' and prosrc like '%expense-receipts%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.admin_save_transaction_v1(uuid,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: save_body_is_the_s89_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'ff48081b485cacf547a1692d7641d85b' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.admin_save_transaction_v1(uuid,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: save_grant_unchanged_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.admin_save_transaction_v1(uuid,jsonb,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.admin_save_transaction_v1(uuid,jsonb,text)', 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.admin_save_transaction_v1(uuid,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: four_new_functions_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 4 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.oid in ('public.admin_review_queue_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.admin_review_transaction_v1(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure, 'public.expense_categories_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.get_hospitality_series_v1(uuid,integer)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: new_functions_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from aclexplode(p.proacl) a where a.grantee = 0)) from pg_proc p where p.oid in ('public.admin_review_queue_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.admin_review_transaction_v1(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,text)'::regprocedure, 'public.expense_categories_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'public.get_hospitality_series_v1(uuid,integer)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: metrics_function_untouched
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '36783f8532b14960e1563acba000d104' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.get_hospitality_metrics_v1(uuid,date,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: every_property_has_the_six_added_slugs
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.expense_categories e group by e.property_id having count(*) filter (where e.slug in ('internet','subscription','furnishing','cohost_fee','airbnb_adjustment','loan')) <> 6)

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback restores admin_save_transaction_v1 to the md5 147e217b6c7a14f264f7dfce43b8bb2f body, drops the four new functions and removes the six added slugs unless a transaction already uses them. Receipt paths already saved stay on their rows (the columns existed before).

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261023_s89_admin_hub.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh. Roll the Staff app back first: Manage calls the new functions.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_probes_the_new_rpcs
feature_flags.required_state: None. The Staff app hides Scan receipt, the review queue and the series chart while an RPC answers PGRST202.

compatibility.evidence: admin_save_transaction_v1 keeps its signature, grant and every old behaviour; the new keys are read only when present. The admin dashboard (saveTransaction, TxnDraft) never sends receipt_image_path, so it is unaffected. The dashboard review queue still writes the transactions table directly and keeps working. get_hospitality_metrics_v1 is called, not changed. The six added category slugs are already used by 26 live expense rows and by the Manage hub list.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
